text: {"lessons":["Selling a stock just because it is showing a gain can mean buying it back later at a higher price; I should base trades on its current outlook and portfolio role, not my purchase price.","My account rose and then fell over these periods, but random price moves are not reliable signals; I should avoid reacting to short-term performance alone.","Before buying or selling, I should consider the effect on my overall portfolio and keep enough cash for choices, rather than treating each stock as a separate account."]}
